commands.name: status
commands.description: Report the editor version, whether a scene is playing, and the open scene.

commands.name: scene_tree
commands.description: Show the node tree of the open scene.

commands.name: rename_node
commands.description: Rename a node.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node; '.' targets the scene root.

arguments.name: new_name
arguments.help: The new node name.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: create_node
commands.description: Add a new node under another node.

arguments.name: parent_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the parent; '.' targets the scene root.

arguments.name: class_name
arguments.help: Built-in Node subclass to create.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Name of the new node.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: set_property
commands.description: Set one property on a node.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node.

arguments.name: property
arguments.help: Property name.

arguments.name: value
arguments.help: Parsed as JSON when it parses, otherwise sent as a plain string; the plugin coerces it to the declared type.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: inspect_node
commands.description: Show a node's class, child count, and property values.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node; '.' targets the scene root.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: query_nodes
commands.description: Find nodes in the open scene by class, group, or name.

arguments.name: class
arguments.help: Keep nodes of this class.

arguments.name: group
arguments.help: Keep nodes in this group.

arguments.name: name
arguments.help: Keep nodes matching this glob pattern.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.help: Maximum nodes to return, an integer; the plugin checks the range.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: inspect_class
commands.description: Show an engine class's properties, methods, and signals.

arguments.name: class
arguments.help: Engine class name.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: list_resources
commands.description: List the resource files the editor file system holds.

arguments.name: path_prefix
arguments.help: Keep entries whose path starts with this string.

arguments.name: type
arguments.help: Keep entries whose engine class equals or inherits this class.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.help: Page bound, an integer; the plugin checks the range.

arguments.name: cursor
arguments.help: Resume after the last path of the previous page.

arguments.name: refresh
arguments.help: Start a file-system scan and wait for it to finish before listing.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: inspect_resource
commands.description: Show one resource file's class, typed properties, and embedded sub-resources.

arguments.name: resource_path
arguments.help: A res:// path that is not a scene or script file; a symlink that escapes the project is rejected before sending.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: delete_node
commands.description: Remove a node and its subtree.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node; the scene root is rejected.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: connect_signal
commands.description: Connect a signal on one node to a method on another node.

arguments.name: source_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the signal source.

arguments.name: signal
arguments.help: Signal name.

arguments.name: target_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the method target.

arguments.name: method
arguments.help: Method name.

arguments.name: deferred
arguments.help: Add the deferred connect flag.

arguments.name: one_shot
arguments.help: Add the one-shot connect flag.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: set_group
commands.description: Add or remove a persistent group on a node.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node.

arguments.name: group
arguments.help: Group name.

arguments.name: remove
arguments.help: Remove the group instead of adding it.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: set_unique_name
commands.description: Set or clear a node's % unique name.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node.

arguments.name: remove
arguments.help: Clear the flag instead of setting it.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: instantiate_scene
commands.description: Add an instance of a scene under a node.

arguments.name: scene_path
arguments.help: A res:// .tscn or .scn path that loads as a PackedScene.

arguments.name: parent_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative parent path; the scene root or a node owned by it.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: save_scene
commands.description: Save the open scene to its existing file.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: open_scene
commands.description: Open a scene in the editor; with --save, save the current scene first.

arguments.name: scene_path
arguments.help: Scene path; res://, relative, absolute-inside-project, '..' or uid:// as long as it resolves inside the project.

arguments.name: save
arguments.help: Save the dirty edited scene first; without it the dirty scene stays open as a background tab.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: console
commands.description: Show the editor log messages captured since the plugin loaded.

arguments.name: tail
arguments.help: Keep only the last N matching messages; the plugin checks the range.

arguments.name: level
arguments.help: Keep messages of this level: all, info, warning, error, script or shader.

arguments.name: since
arguments.help: Keep messages with a sequence number greater than this cursor.

arguments.name: clear
arguments.help: Empty the buffer after the reply is built.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: set_parent
commands.description: Move a node under a new parent as one Undo/Redo step.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node to move; the scene root is rejected.

arguments.name: new_parent_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the new parent; '.' targets the scene root.

arguments.name: index
arguments.help: Position among the new parent's children, an integer; default appends.

arguments.name: keep_global_transform
arguments.help: Keep the full global transform of a Node2D or Node3D and the global position only of a Control; other nodes ignore it.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: eval
commands.description: Run a GDScript snippet in the live editor and return its value. A snippet that switches scenes is outside the dirty-marking guarantee; check status for unsaved scenes.

arguments.name: code
arguments.help: A complete GDScript source defining func run(editor, undo_redo).

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.help: Best-effort timeout in milliseconds; the call is never interrupted.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.

commands.name: attach_script
commands.description: Attach, replace or detach a node's GDScript.

arguments.name: node_path
arguments.help: Scene-relative path of the node.

arguments.name: script_path
arguments.help: res:// path of the GDScript to attach; omit it when passing --detach.

arguments.name: detach
arguments.help: Remove the node's script instead of attaching one.

arguments.name: replace
arguments.help: Allow attaching a different script to a node that already has one.

arguments.name: project_path
arguments.help: Absolute path of the target project; canonicalized before sending.
